contract: BB4 (docs/design/beta_basics_2026-10-05.md): Config.CombatPower(level, tier, +N) = floor(PowerOf(level, tier, 1, +N) x DisplayScale 10 + 0.5) for a weapon (A23-34: bare hands count from 0: Lv1 0, Lv2 12) with samples 283 (Lv1 T1) / 387 (Lv1 T2) / 758 (Lv5 T3) / 1,052 (Lv10 T3 +3) / 2,829 (Lv20 T5), Lv1 T8 872 < Lv1 T4 938, MaxCombatPower() = 25,488 (Lv100, highest-damage weapon, +10; cached; tier-index cap would be 7,027); rises with level and +N, ordered by weapon Damage; Config.Power.Text (Label/Up/Change/Formula + En; PvPNote / PvPNoteEn are finished lines built right after Config.PvP: strings with no '%', following PowerRatioMax / PowerRatioMin and equal to exactly (A23-48: both) 'However strong the weapons, PvP damage is at most x<Max> and at least x<Min>' (full-sentence compare: max first, min second) and Config.Bully.Text (Title + 3 lines KO/EN built from WeakPowerRatio 50% / FreshSpawnSeconds 15 / RepeatKOs 3 in RepeatWindow 10 min); JusticeService.GetCombatPower = Config.CombatPowerOf(player) (A23-69: Config.CombatPower from the Level / WeaponTier / WeaponEnhance attributes + StatAtk / StatHp, which count only with the StatPoints switch on; no rebirth bonus), GetPower unchanged; the CombatPower attribute is set on PlayerReady, follows Level / WeaponTier / WeaponEnhance (+ StatAtk / StatHp) with ONE task.defer-coalesced refresh per frame (an equip = one change) and is disconnected on PlayerLeaving; PvPService combatPower fallback = Config.CombatPowerOf (the attributes), BoldMult x2 at ratio >= 1.2, x0.5 below 0.8, bully weak test victim < 50% of killer, all on the displayed integer. BB16: Data Titles {} / TitleSel "" (TitleSel mirrored), Config.TitleDefs / TitleOrder / Beta (GrantPioneer, PioneerUntil 2026-12-19 11:00 KST); BetaPioneer granted on PlayerReady before PioneerUntil (legacy data.BetaPioneer always); no automatic selection: a grant never sets TitleSel (it stays "", the faction rank stays the title, no TitleSel SetStat; only the player's SetTitle picks); legacy rows from the first build (TitleSel "BetaPioneer" without TitleSelAt) go back to "" once at ready (SetTitle records TitleSelAt, so an explicit pick is kept); the pioneer shows as a mark on the nametag's second line (CharacterVisuals, static check); a "" choice survives rejoin, GrantPioneer=false stops new grants; GrayLegend when FallMarks and RedeemMarks >= Rebirth.GrayLegendMin (at ready and on change); TitlesOwned = owned TitleOrder ids joined by ","; unowned/unknown TitleSel -> "" at ready; SetTitle remote: exactly one string <= 32 chars, "" or owned, ready, RateLimits.SetTitle 0.5 s, else ignored; titles never change stats; DisplayTitle order session > selected > gray legend > rank.
limitations: Offline doubles: DataStore = in-memory rows (deep copies), PlayerService ready/leave flow and signals modelled on the real one (real SetStat / AddStat), LootService reduced to its WeaponEnhance attribute writes, attribute-changed signals fire immediately and only on a real change, task.defer flushed by the fixture, os.time / os.clock doubles. PvPService is tested through extracted helpers (num, combatPower, BoldMult, the bully weak line), not the whole KO flow. Client HUD / CharacterVisuals / BB8 picker are only checked statically. Studio play, replication and multiple clients are not certified here.
